name: Hôtel Opéra Liège
summary: A hotel on rue de Liège in the 9th, the arrondissement that holds Opéra Garnier.
description: Hôtel Opéra Liège is at 9 rue de Liège, in the 9th arrondissement. Booking.com places it on that street, north of Opéra Garnier and toward Gare Saint-Lazare. The rate printed here is the Classic Room the listing showed for two adults on 10–11 November 2026.
facts: The checked room is the Classic Room
Booking.com showed the rate before VAT and city tax
